'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Michael Pistone DS Drop''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Michael Pistone]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Sheet name Mike Pistone; published [[Michael Pistone]]. Deck title Move Both Feet Off The Floor / Move Bith Get Out The Way. No numbered Objective; starts [[Endor: Forest Clearing]]. WMAOP → [[We Must Accelerate Our Plans]]. EPP Vader → [[Darth Vader With Lightsaber]]. Breached Defenses without (V).
